cause_quote: The new webhook guard called `isDeferredCronAdmission(job, result)`, whose predicate required both `result.admissionDeferred === true` and `result.triggerEval === undefined`, so empty-scratch skips and deferrals after a fired trigger fell through to delivery.
user_saw: Webhook receivers got a finished event containing a skip reason when an automation never started.
summary: The fix suppresses primary webhook delivery for skipped runs that never started, while preserving delivery of output and errors.
reasoning: The path history and introducing diff show that #179387 added the affected pre-execution skip paths and the webhook guard together. I checked that the same commit carried fired trigger results into delivery and sent nonempty summaries as finished events, so both skip cases could post from the moment they shipped.
